title: Create: Liquid Chutes
description: Liquid chutes - free 1 block distance fluid transfer!
body:
Free 1 block liquid transfer. Straight down or round a corner!
For use with Create, but not an auto-include in any Create modpack. This is intended for those experienced with Create and looking to build smaller factories. This mod will let you skip pumps, cogs and power for the pump, but only if the fluid source is within 1 block range. Very useful to provide fuel for diesel engines, or for water for steam engines.
